episodes.176633: An extended period of deep layered moisture and moderate instability generated periods of heavy rainfall and localized flooding impacts across portions of Maui County.
episodes.176989: Heavy rain brought river flooding to parts of Arkansas in late January. The Ouachita River and the White River were affected.
episodes.177200: South winds briefly gusted to storm force on the morning of the 27th at Stannard Rock Light.

events.narrative: Heavy rain brought river flooding to the Ouachita River at Thatcher Lock and Dam in late January.

events.county: Manitou Island To Marquette Mi And W Of Grand Marais Mi To Us/Canadian Border Beyond 5Nm Of Shore
events.narrative: The Stannard Rock Light C-MAN station briefly had south storm force wind gusts on the morning of the 27th.

Flash flooding closed Pulehu Road was above the landfill, South Kihei Road near Kulanihakoi Gulch, and Piilani Highway near Nuu. A firefighter helping to clear flood waters was swept into a storm drain and carried about 800 yards to the ocean at around 1 pm HST. He succumbed to injuries on February 4, 2023.
